symptomShortText: Flange edge burr above limit after milling
defectText: Flange edge burr above limit
internalSummary: Internal defect Q3 identified on batch B-49172 of Bracket Housing X240 with 128 PCE rejected at WC-MILL-07 due to out-of-spec flange burr height (0.32 mm vs 0.10 mm limit) and flatness (0.09 mm vs 0.05 mm limit). Issue isolated specifically to fixture WC-MILL-07-F1 due to mechanical degradation and alignment offset, while WC-MILL-07-F2 produced conforming parts. Immediate actions require batch quarantine, production halt on WC-MILL-07-F1, and manual sorting. Planned corrective actions include fixture rebuild, Z-axis datum recalibration, tooling replacement, and FMEA-MILL-2024 updates. Case 8D-10048412 remains open pending team roster assignment, physical execution, and dimensional verification.
